# v2026.10.52

This release covers **10 pull requests, with thanks to 1 contributor.**

## Highlights

- Match a capture to a job, and the Capture page on phone and desk. ([#376](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/376)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- Seazona history read resumes, skips orders read before, and shows live progress. ([#390](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/390))
- Pick a rule's icon with a shared icon picker. ([#400](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/400))
- Short problem labels and a calm phone row on Invoices. ([#381](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/381))
- Remove the expired stage move notice. ([#384](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/384))
- Keep long Bill to and Reference text inside their invoice header columns. ([#397](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/397))
- Wrap long help tips in their box, and fold Sentry's technical settings under Advanced. ([#420](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/420))
- Price list on the shared list head, window and chips. ([#421](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/421))
